We care your mobile as babies
The Problem

Broken phone?
No trust. No transparency. No tracking.

No Trusted Repair Shop

Finding a reliable service center is a gamble.

Hidden Costs

Price surprises after repair completion.

Zero Visibility

No idea what is happening to your device.

The Solution

Emobies — register a complaint, get doorstep pickup, track every repair step in real-time, pay securely via Razorpay, and earn EmoCoins with every repair.

How It Works

From complaint to delivery in four simple steps

01

Register Complaint

Login & book your service easily on the Emobies app with device details and issue type.

02

We Pick Up

Our agent conveniently picks up your device from your doorstep with live GPS tracking.

03

Expert Repair

Professional service at our verified centers with photo documentation and status updates.

04

Delivered

We track and deliver your repaired device safely back to your hands.

Powerful Features

Everything you need for a seamless repair experience

Smart Complaints

Register with device details, issue type, and photos for accurate diagnosis.

Live Tracking

GPS-based pickup & delivery with real-time Google Maps integration.

AI-Monitored Chat

Per-complaint chat with Emo AI oversight for quality assurance.

EmoCoins

Earn 1 coin per Rs.100 spent. Redeem up to 50% of your repair bill.

Emo AI Support

Customer support in Malayalam + English. No hallucinations, only facts.

Biometric Auth

Fingerprint & face unlock for secure staff access and operations.

Razorpay

Secure payments with instant verification and multiple payment modes.

Admin Analytics

Real-time dashboards, staff performance metrics, and complaint insights.

Telegram Alerts

Instant notifications for staff logins, status updates, and alerts.

Built for Every Role

One platform. Multiple perspectives. Seamless coordination.

Customer

The heart of the ecosystem
  • Register complaints with photos & details
  • Track repair status in real-time
  • Chat with service center per complaint
  • Pay securely & earn EmoCoins

Delivery Agent

The logistics backbone
  • Pickup & drop devices with GPS tracking
  • Upload condition photos at pickup
  • Confirm delivery locations digitally
  • Biometric-verified handovers

Service Center

The repair experts
  • Receive devices with digital manifests
  • Diagnose & update repair status
  • Chat with customers per complaint
  • Upload repair photos & invoices

Supervisor & Admin

The command center
  • Assign complaints to agents & centers
  • Monitor all chats with AI oversight
  • Full analytics & staff management
  • Real-time dashboard & performance metrics
